nodes.name: Create Query Embedding
nodes.notes: Creates embedding for the user query using OpenAI's embedding model. Change model to text-embedding-3-large or text-embedding-ada-002 as needed.

nodes.name: Prepare Hybrid Search Payload
nodes.notes: Combines the query embedding with the weights and parameters passed by the AI agent

nodes.name: Call Hybrid Search Edge Function
nodes.notes: Calls the Supabase edge function with the prepared payload

nodes.name: Format Results for AI
nodes.notes: Formats the results in a way that's easy for the AI agent to consume
